clauses.reason: This order amends section 2 of Executive Order No. 11861, as amended, which places positions in level V, by adding two positions: (14) Assistant to the Secretary and Land Utilization Adviser, Department of the Interior, and (15) Executive Assistant and Counselor to the Secretary, Department of Labor. Terminated by Executive Order 12076, signed August 18, 1978, whose section 1-202 states "Executive Order No. 11861, as amended, is hereby revoked." No effective-date sentence delaying that revocation appears in the held text of Executive Order 12076, so the effective date is the signing date.

research_rationale:
Identity: the held Federal Register text (42 FR 33255, issue of June 30, 1977) is Executive Order 11999, an order placing or changing positions in level V of the Executive Schedule by amending Executive Order No. 11861, signed June 27, 1977. I read the whole order; the representation is the machine-extracted text layer of the official PDF and page images were not inspected. End: Executive Order 12076, signed August 18, 1978 (43 FR 37161, issue of August 22, 1978), revokes Executive Order No. 11861 as amended, the parent whose text this order amended; an amending order has no separate text once its parent is revoked, and the same order re-places the position in its own lists, so the placement continues after that date only under Executive Order 12076. Executive Order 12076 does not name this order by number; the end is recorded because it names and revokes the order this order amends, under the owner rulings of 2026-10-21 on strike-and-insert amendments (the clause continues, amended, until the parent ends) and on unnamed instruments (the instrument that names the target is the end). Every later amendment of Executive Order 11861 in the dossier chain was read; none strikes, revises or deletes the two positions this order added.

No held text revokes or supersedes this order by number; the held text of Executive Order 12076 is the first that revokes the parent. savings.reason: Executive Order 12076 section 1-201 states "Nothing in this Order shall be deemed to terminate or otherwise", concerning the appointment of any occupant of a position listed in its section 1-1 who held it immediately before that order. Both positions added by this order appear among the level V positions in section 1-102 of Executive Order 12076. Placement as of the revocation therefore continues under Executive Order 12076, and appointments of existing occupants are not terminated by it.
